purpose: Verify that authorized Institute Employee (Faculty/Staff) can perform operational file actions.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee with assigned role.
action_or_input: Employee performs file creation and movement operations.
expected_result: Operational file actions proceed successfully.

purpose: Verify that System Admin is prohibited from performing routine operational file actions.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to create or forward an operational file.
expected_result: FTS denies the action; operational processing is blocked for System Admin.

purpose: Verify that System Admin is permitted to perform governance actions within administrative scope.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin performs role assignment or accesses audit logs.
expected_result: Governance actions succeed within administrative boundary.

purpose: Verify that role switching updates active authorization context for subsequent operations.
preconditions: Institute Employee with multiple assigned roles (e.g. Faculty and Warden).
action_or_input: Employee switches active role context from Faculty to Warden.
expected_result: Active role permissions are updated and applied to subsequent operations.

purpose: Verify that switching assigned role context does not change ownership of previously created files.
preconditions: Employee created a file under role A; employee also holds role B.
action_or_input: Employee switches role context to role B.
expected_result: Previously created file retains original owner identity; ownership is not altered or transferred.

purpose: Verify that switching role context does not alter previously recorded audit history records.
preconditions: File with recorded audit history entries under role A.
action_or_input: User switches active role context to role B.
expected_result: Historical audit records remain unchanged with original actor and role identities preserved.

purpose: Verify that an FTS file is maintained as a persistent composite object with mandatory comments and optional attachments.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create file with mandatory comment and optional attachment.
expected_result: File object is stored containing both mandatory comment and attachment reference.

purpose: Verify that circulated file contents and movement records are retained and cannot be deleted.
preconditions: Circulated file with accumulated comments and attachments.
action_or_input: Attempt to delete or purge comments or attachments from the circulated file.
expected_result: Deletion is prevented; all accumulated contents and movement history remain intact.

purpose: Verify stated exception that pre-submission drafts may be discarded before circulation.
preconditions: Pre-circulation draft file owned by employee.
action_or_input: Employee initiates Discard on the pre-submission draft.
expected_result: Draft file is discarded and removed from active files.

purpose: Verify that file creation succeeds when a non-empty initial mandatory comment is supplied.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Submit file creation request with non-empty comment.
expected_result: File creation is accepted and persisted.

purpose: Verify that file creation is blocked when the initial mandatory comment is empty or missing.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Attempt to create file with empty or missing comment.
expected_result: Creation is blocked with validation error; no file is persisted.

purpose: Verify that draft save, edit, and discard operations are permitted in pre-circulation state.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create draft, edit draft fields, and save updated draft.
expected_result: Draft operations succeed in pre-circulation state.

purpose: Verify that once submitted and circulated, a file cannot be discarded or deleted as a draft.
preconditions: File has been submitted and circulated to another employee.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke draft discard on the circulated file.
expected_result: Action is rejected; circulated files cannot be deleted.

purpose: Verify that submitting a draft transitions it to circulated workflow state.
preconditions: Pre-circulation draft file.
action_or_input: Submit file to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File transitions from draft to circulated state; file appears in recipient inbox.

purpose: Verify that forward action succeeds when mandatory movement comment is supplied.
preconditions: Active file held by sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender executes Forward with non-empty movement comment.
expected_result: Forward succeeds; movement comment is recorded.

purpose: Verify that forward action is blocked when mandatory movement comment is missing or empty.
preconditions: Active file held by sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender attempts to forward file without providing movement comment.
expected_result: Forward is blocked with validation error; file holder is unchanged.

purpose: Verify that return action succeeds when mandatory movement comment is supplied.
preconditions: Active file held by recipient; previous sender known.
action_or_input: Recipient executes Return with non-empty movement comment.
expected_result: Return succeeds; movement comment is recorded.

purpose: Verify that return action is blocked when mandatory movement comment is missing or empty.
preconditions: Active file held by recipient; previous sender known.
action_or_input: Recipient attempts Return without providing movement comment.
expected_result: Return is blocked with validation error; file holder is unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a file can be sent to any valid Institute Employee regardless of receiver role.
preconditions: Active file held by sender; target recipient is an employee with any valid role.
action_or_input: Forward file to recipient employee.
expected_result: Forwarding succeeds regardless of receiver administrative or academic role.

purpose: Verify that forwarding to an invalid or non-existent recipient is rejected.
preconditions: Active file held by sender.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward file to non-existent user identifier.
expected_result: Forwarding is rejected with validation error; file remains with sender.

purpose: Verify that return routes strictly to the sender of the received movement.
preconditions: Active file held by recipient B, received from sender A.
action_or_input: Recipient B initiates Return.
expected_result: File is routed back to previous sender A.

purpose: Verify that return cannot be routed to an arbitrary third party who was not the previous sender.
preconditions: Active file held by recipient B, received from sender A; third employee C exists.
action_or_input: Attempt to return file specifying employee C as target.
expected_result: Return action to non-previous sender is rejected or routes strictly to sender A.

purpose: Verify that movement records capture sender, receiver, timestamp, comment, and attachments.
preconditions: File forwarded with mandatory comment and optional attachment.
action_or_input: Inspect recorded movement in history.
expected_result: Movement record contains sender, receiver, timestamp, comment, and attachment reference.

purpose: Verify that sequential movements append chronologically without overwriting prior records.
preconditions: File subjected to multiple forwards and returns.
action_or_input: Inspect full movement history sequence.
expected_result: All events are ordered chronologically; prior events are preserved intact.

purpose: Verify that current file holder is consistently updated across forward and return actions.
preconditions: File forwarded from A to B, then returned from B to A.
action_or_input: Verify holder status after forward and after return.
expected_result: Holder updates to B after forward, and updates to A after return.

purpose: Verify that received files are visible and accessible in recipient Inbox.
preconditions: File forwarded to recipient.
action_or_input: Recipient queries Inbox.
expected_result: File appears in recipient Inbox and can be opened.

purpose: Verify that sent files are visible and accessible in sender Outbox.
preconditions: File forwarded by sender.
action_or_input: Sender queries Outbox.
expected_result: File appears in sender Outbox and can be opened.

purpose: Verify that users not associated with a file cannot view its contents or history.
preconditions: File exists where user X has no association (not creator, sender, recipient, or current holder).
action_or_input: User X attempts to view file details or history.
expected_result: Access is denied; no file content or history is exposed.

purpose: Verify that archived files remain readable to authorized associated users.
preconditions: Archived file with prior association to user.
action_or_input: Associated user opens archived file.
expected_result: File content and history are retrievable in read-only format.

purpose: Verify that an action is permitted when user role, file association, and file state align.
preconditions: Employee is authorized current holder of an active file.
action_or_input: Employee initiates Forward with valid recipient and comment.
expected_result: Action is permitted and executed successfully.

purpose: Verify that action is rejected when user role lacks required permissions.
preconditions: User role does not possess file-creation or movement permissions.
action_or_input: User attempts the restricted action.
expected_result: Action is rejected with authorization failure.

purpose: Verify that action is rejected when file state does not permit the requested operation.
preconditions: File is in archived state.
action_or_input: Attempt to perform forward or edit operation on archived file.
expected_result: Action is rejected; file state prevents further collaborative movement.

purpose: Verify that creation, comments, attachments, forward, return, and archival actions append audit records.
preconditions: File undergoes creation, movement, comments, attachments, and archival.
action_or_input: Inspect audit log for the file.
expected_result: Audit entries exist for each action type with actor, timestamp, and action details.

purpose: Verify that prior audit records cannot be rewritten or modified.
preconditions: Audit records exist for past file actions.
action_or_input: Attempt to update, overwrite, or delete existing audit log entries.
expected_result: Modification of audit records is rejected; audit history remains append-only.

purpose: Verify that auditable actions performed via integration APIs generate audit records.
preconditions: Consuming module performs file action via FTS API.
action_or_input: Inspect audit log entries.
expected_result: Audit record logs action with external module/client attribution.

purpose: Verify that file owner can archive a completed circulated file.
preconditions: Circulated file where actor is the file owner.
action_or_input: Owner requests file archival.
expected_result: File status transitions to Archived / Read-only.

purpose: Verify that non-owners are prohibited from archiving the file.
preconditions: Circulated file; actor is a recipient but not the owner.
action_or_input: Non-owner attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: Archival request is denied; file remains active.

purpose: Verify that modification of an archived file is prohibited.
preconditions: File is in archived status.
action_or_input: Attempt to add comments or attachments to archived file.
expected_result: Modification request is denied; archived file remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that forwarding of an archived file is prohibited.
preconditions: File is in archived status.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward archived file to another user.
expected_result: Forwarding request is denied; archived file remains in archived status.

purpose: Verify that forward action triggers file-received and file-forwarded notification events.
preconditions: Active file forwarded from sender to recipient.
action_or_input: Observe triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification events for file-forwarded and file-received are generated and dispatched.

purpose: Verify that return action triggers file-returned notification event.
preconditions: Active file returned by recipient to previous sender.
action_or_input: Observe triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file-returned is generated and dispatched.

purpose: Verify that archival action triggers file-archived notification event.
preconditions: File owner archives circulated file.
action_or_input: Observe triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file-archived is generated and dispatched.

purpose: Verify that FTS-relevant role assignment or reassignment triggers role notification event.
preconditions: System Admin assigns or reassigns an FTS role.
action_or_input: Observe triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for role assignment/reassignment is generated and dispatched.

purpose: Verify that authorized consuming module can access FTS tracking and workflow APIs under RBAC and audit.
preconditions: Authorized external module with valid credentials.
action_or_input: Consuming module invokes FTS workflow or tracking API.
expected_result: FTS executes requested service and logs audit record.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized external module requests are rejected.
preconditions: Unauthenticated or unauthorized external client.
action_or_input: Client attempts to call FTS integration API.
expected_result: Request is rejected with HTTP 401/403 authorization error.

purpose: Verify that FTS does not assume ownership of consuming module domain-specific approval policy.
preconditions: Consuming module sends approval workflow action.
action_or_input: Consuming module invokes FTS API for request tracking.
expected_result: FTS performs tracking service without evaluating or enforcing external domain approval criteria.
